remarks:
Great opportunity to own a 0.8-acre vacant lot in the desirable Shorehaven Private Community. This spacious property offers flexibility of building a full time residence or a seasonal property with investment potential. A mostly cleared lot, with berry bushes in abundance. It's a short walk to the multiple private waterfront access points, and only 4 miles to town.

Enjoy the benefits of the community with no HOA fees while the lot remains vacant. Once a home is built, the HOA fee is only $500 per year, making it an affordable option compared to many other private communities.

Whether you're looking to build your dream home, or just looking for vacant land, this property provides excellent possibilities in a quiet and private neighborhood setting.  Owner financing may be available. Owner is willing to subdivide the .8 acres into 2-.4 acre parcels. $36,900 for the whole .8 acre, or each .4 acre to be sold at $24,900.
